annotation.bound_parties_text: The amended regulations bind UAS operators, manufacturers, importers, distributors, approved conformity assessment bodies, and public authorities such as the CAA, the Secretary of State and market surveillance authorities.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The Secretary of State may approve bodies to carry out third-party conformity assessment tasks under this Regulation.
annotation.dates_quote: Subject to paragraph (3), these Regulations come into force on IP completion day.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: These Regulations make amendments to the legislative framework for unmanned aircraft.
